content.short: Lendle is a decentralized non-custodial lending market built natively on Mantle, inspired by Aave's proven architecture.
content.description: Lendle is a DeFi lending protocol built natively on Mantle that follows the Aave V2 architecture, offering a familiar and battle-tested borrowing and lending experience for the Mantle ecosystem. Users supply assets to earn yield from borrowers or use their collateral to borrow other tokens at competitive rates. Lendle has grown to become one of the most utilized lending markets on Mantle, with deep liquidity for major assets in the network's DeFi ecosystem.
content.meta: Lendle is a decentralized lending protocol on Mantle inspired by Aave for borrowing and earning yield. Discover Lendle on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
